signing.scheme: Google Play App Signing (upload key signs the AAB; Play manages the distribution key)
signing.rule: Only credential NAMES are recorded here and in CI. Values and keystore files live in the owner's secret manager / protected CI store and are never committed, printed to logs, or sent to worker contexts.

build.webBundle: Build the shared apps/web source first (E12/E14 prerequisite), then sync into the Capacitor shell
artifactChecks: bundletool build-apks from the AAB succeeds
applicationId and versionCode match the release record
no debuggable=true, no plaintext secrets in the bundle

promotionGates.internal: AAB accepted by Play Console internal track; on-device test plan executed with evidence
promotionGates.closed: explicit owner approval + Play policy/data-safety checklist complete
promotionGates.production: explicit owner approval after closed-track soak; never automatic
